data.one_liner: Generate type-safe data classes and runtime JSON Schemas from abstract class definitions.
data.what_it_does: Schemantic is a library that generates fully-typed Dart data classes and runtime-accessible JSON Schemas from simple abstract class definitions. It features built-in JSON serialization, runtime data validation against schemas, and support for recursive structures, union types, and custom types.
use_when: You need to generate runtime JSON Schemas alongside immutable-style data classes from code definitions.
You want built-in runtime validation of JSON payloads against generated schemas.
You work with AI tools or structured output requirements that depend on strict JSON schemas.
avoid_when: You are looking for state management solutions or UI widget component libraries.
You do not want to use code generation and build_runner in your workflow.
strengths: First-class runtime JSON schemas accessible from generated data classes.
Supports recursive schemas and union types (AnyOf).
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and a separate builder package for code generation.
Adds an extra step to the development workflow for schema modifications.
data.setup_notes: Add schemantic, schemantic_builder, and build_runner as dependencies, then run build_runner to generate part files.

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose freezed if you primarily want advanced union types, deep copying, and immutable data classes rather than runtime JSON schema generation.
